overview_description.description: DP World is a logistics company that enhances global trade through efficient cargo logistics and port terminal operations. The company specializes in port operations, maritime services, logistics, and free trade zones and serves as a key enabler of global trade. DP World has a vast network of assets and operations that span Asia, Africa, Europe, the Americas, and the Middle East, offering solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of regional markets.

about_short_description.short_description: DP World is a logistics and supply chain company that enhances global trade through efficient cargo logistics and port terminal operations.

product.name: Ports & Terminals
product.description: Operates more than 60 global ports and terminals for container, vehicle, bulk, breakbulk and cruise cargo handling, linking maritime trade with inland logistics.

product.name: Contract Logistics
product.description: Provides outsourced logistics operations that manage storage, inventory and related supply-chain activities for customers seeking scalable and cost-controlled distribution capabilities.

product.name: Freight Forwarding
product.description: Arranges international cargo transportation through a global office network and coordinates shipments across maritime, inland and other transport connections.

product.name: Marine Services
product.description: Provides ocean transport and maritime logistics for cargo such as raw materials and vehicles, using a fleet of more than 500 vessels.

product.name: Economic Zones
product.description: Provides trade and industrial zones connected to ports, combining warehousing, manufacturing, logistics, multimodal transport and selected customs or tax advantages.

product.name: Market Access
product.description: Helps businesses enter and scale in international markets by connecting them with trade routes, logistics infrastructure and distribution capabilities.
